name: Tree-Like Partial Cubes Are Not Conditioning-Closed
statement: A coordinate conditioning of a tree-like partial cube need not be tree-like.
proof: For any finite partial cube $H\hookrightarrow Q_n$, peripherally expand the tree-like cube $Q_n$ along $H$. Conditioning the new coordinate to its added semicube recovers $H$. Choosing a non-tree-like $H$, such as $C_6$, proves failure of closure.
